content.comment_body: Is there a command that can be sent to the [article_no] via ethernet to determine the RUN/STOP status of the machine? Thank you in advance.

As far as I know, there isn’t a direct solution for this. You could program a flag that updates while the [product_name] is in RUN mode. If it stops updating, it could mean either the device is in STOP or the connection has been lost. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants a simple method to remotely check the RUN/STOP status of a [article_no] unit via Ethernet, but finds that no built-in feature exists for this purpose. Users mention the need for custom solutions, such as programming status flags, highlighting a gap in remote monitoring capabilities straight from the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an out-of-the-box Ethernet command or direct functionality for remote RUN/STOP status monitoring, without requiring custom programming.
